# tag: school.english.prefixes
what does the prefix un mean | prefix un meaning | what does un mean as a prefix | words with the prefix un => The prefix un- means not, or the opposite of. Examples: unhappy (not happy), untie (the opposite of tie).
what does the prefix re mean | prefix re meaning | what does re mean as a prefix | words with the prefix re => The prefix re- means again or back. Examples: redo (do again), return (turn back).
what does the prefix dis mean | prefix dis meaning | what does dis mean as a prefix | words with the prefix dis => The prefix dis- means not, or the opposite of. Examples: disagree, dishonest, disappear.
what does the prefix pre mean | prefix pre meaning | what does pre mean as a prefix | words with the prefix pre => The prefix pre- means before. Examples: preview (see before), preheat, prehistoric.
what does the prefix post mean | prefix post meaning | what does post mean as a prefix | words with the prefix post => The prefix post- means after. Examples: postpone, postwar, postscript (P.S., written after).
what does the prefix mis mean | prefix mis meaning | what does mis mean as a prefix | words with the prefix mis => The prefix mis- means wrongly or badly. Examples: misspell, misunderstand, mislead.
what does the prefix non mean | prefix non meaning | what does non mean as a prefix | words with the prefix non => The prefix non- means not. Examples: nonfiction, nonstop, nonsense.
what does the prefix in mean | prefix in meaning | what does in mean as a prefix | words with the prefix in => The prefix in- means not, or into. Examples: invisible (not visible), inactive, include (shut into). It changes to im- before b, m and p (impossible), il- before l (illegal) and ir- before r (irregular).
what does the prefix il mean | prefix il meaning | what does il mean as a prefix | words with the prefix il => The prefix il- means not. Examples: illegal, illogical, illiterate. It's a form of in- used before l.
what does the prefix ir mean | prefix ir meaning | what does ir mean as a prefix | words with the prefix ir => The prefix ir- means not. Examples: irregular, irresponsible, irrelevant. It's a form of in- used before r.
what does the prefix sub mean | prefix sub meaning | what does sub mean as a prefix | words with the prefix sub => The prefix sub- means under or below. Examples: submarine (under the sea), subway, subtract.
what does the prefix super mean | prefix super meaning | what does super mean as a prefix | words with the prefix super => The prefix super- means above, over or extra. Examples: superhero, superstar, supervise.
what does the prefix inter mean | prefix inter meaning | what does inter mean as a prefix | words with the prefix inter => The prefix inter- means between or among. Examples: international, internet, interrupt.
what does the prefix intra mean | prefix intra meaning | what does intra mean as a prefix | words with the prefix intra => The prefix intra- means within. Examples: intramural (within one school), intravenous (within a vein).
what does the prefix trans mean | prefix trans meaning | what does trans mean as a prefix | words with the prefix trans => The prefix trans- means across or beyond. Examples: transport (carry across), transatlantic, translate.
what does the prefix anti mean | prefix anti meaning | what does anti mean as a prefix | words with the prefix anti => The prefix anti- means against. Examples: antibiotic, antifreeze, antisocial.

# tag: school.english.suffixes
what does the suffix able mean | suffix able meaning | what does able mean as a suffix | words with the suffix able => The suffix -able means can be done, or worth. Examples: readable, washable, comfortable. -ible means the same: visible, flexible.
what does the suffix ible mean | suffix ible meaning | what does ible mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ible => The suffix -ible means can be done. Examples: visible, flexible, edible. -able means the same and is more common.
what does the suffix ful mean | suffix ful meaning | what does ful mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ful => The suffix -ful means full of. Examples: joyful, careful, helpful. As a suffix it always has one l.
what does the suffix less mean | suffix less meaning | what does less mean as a suffix | words with the suffix less => The suffix -less means without. Examples: fearless, careless, hopeless.
what does the suffix ness mean | suffix ness meaning | what does ness mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ness => The suffix -ness means a state or quality. Examples: happiness, kindness, darkness. It turns adjectives into nouns.
what does the suffix ment mean | suffix ment meaning | what does ment mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ment => The suffix -ment means an action or result. Examples: movement, enjoyment, agreement. It turns verbs into nouns.
what does the suffix tion mean | suffix tion meaning | what does tion mean as a suffix | words with the suffix tion => The suffix -tion means an act or state. Examples: action, celebration, education. -sion works the same way: decision, explosion.
what does the suffix sion mean | suffix sion meaning | what does sion mean as a suffix | words with the suffix sion => The suffix -sion means an act or state. Examples: decision, explosion, confusion.
what does the suffix er mean | suffix er meaning | what does er mean as a suffix | words with the suffix er => The suffix -er means a person who, or more. Examples: teacher, player (people); taller, faster (more).
what does the suffix or mean | suffix or meaning | what does or mean as a suffix | words with the suffix or => The suffix -or means a person who. Examples: actor, inventor, sailor.
what does the suffix ist mean | suffix ist meaning | what does ist mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ist => The suffix -ist means a person who does or believes. Examples: artist, scientist, cyclist.
what does the suffix ian mean | suffix ian meaning | what does ian mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ian => The suffix -ian means a person who is skilled in or from. Examples: musician, librarian, Canadian.
what does the suffix est mean | suffix est meaning | what does est mean as a suffix | words with the suffix est => The suffix -est means the most. Examples: biggest, fastest, smartest.
what does the suffix ly mean | suffix ly meaning | what does ly mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ly => The suffix -ly means in a certain way. Examples: quickly, sadly, quietly. It usually turns adjectives into adverbs.
what does the suffix y mean | suffix y meaning | what does y mean as a suffix | words with the suffix y => The suffix -y means full of or like. Examples: rainy, sandy, cloudy.
what does the suffix ous mean | suffix ous meaning | what does ous mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ous => The suffix -ous means full of or having. Examples: dangerous, famous, joyous.
what does the suffix ive mean | suffix ive meaning | what does ive mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ive => The suffix -ive means tending to. Examples: active, creative, expensive.
what does the suffix al mean | suffix al meaning | what does al mean as a suffix | words with the suffix al => The suffix -al means relating to. Examples: musical, natural, personal. It can also make nouns from verbs: arrival, refusal.
what does the suffix ic mean | suffix ic meaning | what does ic mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ic => The suffix -ic means relating to. Examples: athletic, poetic, scientific.
what does the suffix ish mean | suffix ish meaning | what does ish mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ish => The suffix -ish means somewhat or like. Examples: childish, reddish, foolish. It can also mean from a place: English, Spanish.
what does the suffix ize mean | suffix ize meaning | what does ize mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ize => The suffix -ize means to make or become. Examples: realize, organize, modernize. British English often spells it -ise.
what does the suffix ify mean | suffix ify meaning | what does ify mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ify => The suffix -ify means to make. Examples: simplify, beautify, classify.
what does the suffix en mean | suffix en meaning | what does en mean as a suffix | words with the suffix en => The suffix -en means to make. Examples: brighten, darken, widen.
what does the suffix ed mean | suffix ed meaning | what does ed mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ed => The suffix -ed means past tense. Examples: jumped, played, walked. It also makes past participles used as adjectives: a broken toy, a tired dog.
what does the suffix ing mean | suffix ing meaning | what does ing mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ing => The suffix -ing means an action happening now. Examples: running, singing, reading. It also makes gerunds and present participles.
what does the suffix s mean | suffix s meaning | what does s mean as a suffix | words with the suffix s => The suffix -s means more than one. Examples: cats, books, chairs. Use -es after s, x, z, ch and sh: boxes, wishes.
what does the suffix hood mean | suffix hood meaning | what does hood mean as a suffix | words with the suffix hood => The suffix -hood means a state or group. Examples: childhood, neighborhood, brotherhood.
what does the suffix ship mean | suffix ship meaning | what does ship mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ship => The suffix -ship means a state or skill. Examples: friendship, leadership, championship.
what does the suffix dom mean | suffix dom meaning | what does dom mean as a suffix | words with the suffix dom => The suffix -dom means a state or realm. Examples: freedom, kingdom, boredom.
what does the suffix ology mean | suffix ology meaning | what does ology mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ology => The suffix -ology means the study of. Examples: biology, geology, zoology.
what does the suffix phobia mean | suffix phobia meaning | what does phobia mean as a suffix | words with the suffix phobia => The suffix -phobia means fear of. Examples: arachnophobia (fear of spiders), claustrophobia.
what does the suffix ward mean | suffix ward meaning | what does ward mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ward => The suffix -ward means in the direction of. Examples: forward, backward, toward.
what does the suffix wise mean | suffix wise meaning | what does wise mean as a suffix | words with the suffix wise => The suffix -wise means in the way of. Examples: clockwise, otherwise, likewise.
what does the suffix ity mean | suffix ity meaning | what does ity mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ity => The suffix -ity means a state or quality. Examples: ability, reality, curiosity.
what does the suffix ance mean | suffix ance meaning | what does ance mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ance => The suffix -ance means an action or state. Examples: performance, appearance, assistance. -ence works the same way: difference, patience.
what does the suffix ence mean | suffix ence meaning | what does ence mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ence => The suffix -ence means an action or state. Examples: difference, patience, existence.
what does the suffix ant mean | suffix ant meaning | what does ant mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ant => The suffix -ant means a person or thing that does, or being. Examples: assistant, servant, pleasant.
what does the suffix ent mean | suffix ent meaning | what does ent mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ent => The suffix -ent means a person or thing that does, or being. Examples: student, resident, different.
what does the suffix ary mean | suffix ary meaning | what does ary mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ary => The suffix -ary means relating to, or a place for. Examples: dictionary, library, imaginary.
what does the suffix cide mean | suffix cide meaning | what does cide mean as a suffix | words with the suffix cide => The suffix -cide means killing. Examples: insecticide, pesticide.
what does the suffix ee mean | suffix ee meaning | what does ee mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ee => The suffix -ee means a person who receives. Examples: employee, trainee, refugee.
what does the suffix ling mean | suffix ling meaning | what does ling mean as a suffix | words with the suffix ling => The suffix -ling means small or young. Examples: duckling, seedling.
what does the suffix meter mean | suffix meter meaning | what does meter mean as a suffix | words with the suffix meter => The suffix -meter means a measuring tool. Examples: thermometer, speedometer.
what does the suffix scope mean | suffix scope meaning | what does scope mean as a suffix | words with the suffix scope => The suffix -scope means a viewing tool. Examples: telescope, microscope, periscope.
what does the suffix graph mean | suffix graph meaning | what does graph mean as a suffix | words with the suffix graph => The suffix -graph means something written or drawn. Examples: autograph, paragraph, photograph.
what does the suffix phone mean | suffix phone meaning | what does phone mean as a suffix | words with the suffix phone => The suffix -phone means sound. Examples: telephone, microphone, saxophone.
